color.note: A palette of its own (graphite, petrol, amber, brick red), defined in OKLCH; no Tailwind default colours. Light is the default theme. Every text token's usage names the grounds it is checked on (WCAG AA 4.5:1); edges, focus and control borders are 3:1 or more. Colour only repeats a status word.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Main page background (the selected run). Text: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Status bar (connected), sidebar, sticky table header, disabled buttons. Text: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Task cards, inputs, secondary buttons. Text: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for list items and secondary or ghost buttons; loading skeletons. Text: `ink` only.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected run in the sidebar, with a 3px `accent` bar. Text: `ink` only.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Diff viewer and long-text boxes. Text: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers, card and table borders, neutral badge outlines. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, textareas and secondary buttons (3:1 on every ground they sit on, `needs-soft` included).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, titles, ids. On every ground and on `danger-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines, labels, helper text, table headers, context lines in diffs. On `canvas`, `panel`, `surface`, `code-bg`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Petrol. Primary buttons (Approve diff, Recover run), the selected-item bar, links. As text on `canvas`, `surface`, `panel`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` and `accent-hover`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every control. 3:1 or more on every ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive outline buttons (Cancel, Reject diff), the solid confirm button, field errors. As text on `canvas`, `surface`, `danger-soft`.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the solid destructive button.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on `danger` and `danger-hover`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Inline-confirm panel and destructive outline button hover. Text: `ink`, `danger`.

tokens.name: needs-soft
tokens.usage: Needs you: AWAITING_APPROVAL badge, the review band, the "No token" status bar, the Interrupted run marker, the live-updates notice. The only amber in the app.

tokens.name: needs-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `needs-soft`.

tokens.name: needs-edge
tokens.usage: Needs you: 2px card border, badge border, the band's top rule, the waiting-diffs count.

tokens.name: working-soft
tokens.usage: Working: ASSIGNED, RUNNING, VALIDATING badges; Active run marker; diff hunk headers.

tokens.name: working-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `working-soft`.

tokens.name: working-edge
tokens.usage: Working: dots and the Connecting icon.

tokens.name: problem-soft
tokens.usage: Problem: FAILED, BLOCKED badges; refusal and page-error alerts; offline, refused and server-error status bars.

tokens.name: problem-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `problem-soft`.

tokens.name: problem-edge
tokens.usage: Problem: alert borders, dots.

tokens.name: done-ink
tokens.usage: Done: the check icon in the COMPLETED badge (badge text stays `ink`), the Connected icon. On `canvas`, `surface`, `panel`.

tokens.name: done-edge
tokens.usage: Done: dots.

tokens.name: waiting-ink
tokens.usage: Waiting: PENDING, READY badge text and icon (outline badge, no fill).

tokens.name: waiting-edge
tokens.usage: Waiting: dots.

tokens.name: held-ink
tokens.usage: Held: PAUSED badge text and icon (outline badge, no fill).

tokens.name: held-edge
tokens.usage: Held: dots.

tokens.name: stopped-ink
tokens.usage: Stopped: CANCELLED badge text and icon (outline badge, no fill).

tokens.name: stopped-edge
tokens.usage: Stopped: dots.

tokens.name: diff-add-soft
tokens.usage: Diff line starting with `+` (not `+++`).

tokens.name: diff-add-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `diff-add-soft`.

tokens.name: diff-del-soft
tokens.usage: Diff line starting with `-` (not `---`).

tokens.name: diff-del-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `diff-del-soft`.

tokens.name: diff-hunk-soft
tokens.usage: Diff hunk header line (`@@ … @@`).

tokens.name: diff-hunk-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `diff-hunk-soft`.

tokens.name: diff-file-soft
tokens.usage: Diff file header lines (`diff --git`, `index`, `---`, `+++`).

tokens.name: diff-file-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `diff-file-soft`, semibold.

tokens.name: diff-ctx-ink
tokens.usage: Unchanged context lines, on `code-bg`, so changed lines stand out.

families.sans: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Run id in the page header. Wraps anywhere; never truncated here.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings (Tasks, History) and task card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Approve the diff to run unit and lint.
styles.usage: Default text: notes, alerts, empty states.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Button and tab labels; sidebar items.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Card meta line, helper text, table cells in dense tables. `ink-muted`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline ids, commands, run ids in the sidebar.

styles.name: code-block
styles.usage: Diff viewer, agent reports, check output. Never rendered as Markdown or HTML.

spacing.note: The same 4px steps as Tailwind v4's default `--spacing: 0.25rem`, so `p-3` = `space-3`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in badges; label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; list item padding; small stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Status bar and sidebar side padding; card header padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card side padding; gap between task cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Main page side padding; gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state and disconnected-screen padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, diff box corners inside cards, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, alerts, sidebar items, diff and long-text boxes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Task cards and the inline-confirm panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status badges and dots only.

size.note: Layout sizes for the 1000×700 window (works down to 800px wide).

tokens.name: statusbar-h
tokens.usage: Status bar height, always visible.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Sidebar width at 1000px and wider.

tokens.name: sidebar-w-narrow
tokens.usage: Sidebar width below 900px window width.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Task-card buttons and buttons inside alerts.

tokens.name: diff-max-h
tokens.usage: Diff viewer box: fixed max height, scrolls both ways.

tokens.name: longtext-max-h
tokens.usage: Agent report and check output boxes: wrap, scroll vertically.

tokens.name: history-max-h
tokens.usage: History table scroll box with a sticky header.

tokens.name: content-max-w
tokens.usage: Main page content stops growing here on wide windows.
